_readme: Seattle Chamber Music Society's own calendar, read by mapsee_ingest_scms.py. Each card's venue label must match a venue below (name or alias, compared without case, spacing or dash style); a card at any other venue is reported in the job log and skipped, never geocoded from the label. The venue labels are the eleven the publisher's own Venues filter listed on 2026-11-28. Points are OpenStreetMap features found through Photon on 2026-11-28. Categories map the publisher's own taxonomy slug (events-categories-*); anything unmapped is music.

sources.name: Seattle Chamber Music Society
sources._categories_note: 2026-11-28: Education holds the composer lectures and the public masterclasses. The Azure page says its concerts are free performances tailored to children and young adults on the autism spectrum, for families to enjoy together, hence kids beside music. Academy (Youth Academy showcases), Signature Series, Winter and Summer Festival, Concerts at the Center and Community stay music.
